statement: I turn ideas into working software, from web apps and automation to connected hardware, and I handle the whole build from architecture to launch.
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer based in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, and the founder of **SR.Automates**, a software studio building web and app products, automation tools and custom software for clients who need something built properly.

My background is in **Electronics & Communication Engineering**, which means I'm as comfortable with a sensor board as I am with a codebase. I've engineered navigation and sensor systems for an autonomous marine vehicle at the **National Institute of Ocean Technology**, and led a computer-vision research team at **Madras Institute of Technology**.

That range is the point: most problems worth solving don't stay neatly inside one discipline. Whether it's a dashboard, an API, a script that removes a week of manual work, or a device in the field, I build it so it keeps working after I hand it over.
